article.headline: Agbaosi scores 22, Mercyhurst defeats SUNY-Fredonia 95-56
article.description: — Deraje Agbaosi had 22 points in Mercyhurst’s 95-56 win against SUNY-Fredonia on Tuesday.

article.story: ERIE, Pa. -- — Deraje Agbaosi had 22 points in Mercyhurst’s 95-56 win against SUNY-Fredonia on Tuesday. Agbaosi added eight rebounds and four steals for the Lakers (4-5). Cameron Johnson scored 22 points, going 8 of 9 and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. Jake Lemelman went 7 of 8 from the field (2 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 18 points, while adding six assists. Nate Mashaw led the way for the Blue Devils with 11 points. Jason Douglas added 10 points for SUNY-Fredonia. Ryan Hough also had eight points. Up next Mercyhurst: visits West Virginia next Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
